title_en: Funny Stories from Life (7/20): Buying the Wrong Soy Sauce Three Times
note_en: 把 moves the object in front of the verb so the sentence can focus on what happens to it: 直接把辣椒油当成了香醋 "he mistook the chili oil for aromatic vinegar." The pattern 把 A 当成 B means "to take A for B" or "to treat A as B"; English keeps the normal verb-object order, but Chinese needs 把 because the verb 当成 is followed by a second element.
